experiment: G3-D F3 longitudinal Plot/Scribe ON vs OFF

SEQ-G.mechanism: Primary RP + Continuity + transcript/context + single-actor Character cognition
SEQ-G.finding: Strongest blind sequence (5.00) without Plot. Ayame Turn-1 housing question preserved as active obligation through four evasions; Turn 4 converts boundary demand into explicit Ayame boundary tied to unanswered question. Proves significant unresolved-thread persistence is achievable without Plot advisory.

SEQ-A.mechanism: Primary RP multi-actor path + Continuity + transcript; Plot lifecycle healthy (init ok → reconciliation → semantic_update)
SEQ-A.finding: Strongest Arkham accumulation under Plot ON, but paired rep-2 Plot-OFF run (SEQ-D, identical player branch) scores 4.8 vs 4.9 — negligible arm delta. Cannot attribute accumulation to Plot without consumer proof.

SEQ-D.mechanism: Same longitudinal substrate as Plot ON without overlay; Narrator spatial-claim completeness debt
SEQ-D.finding: Excellent Harley/Ivy relationship continuity without Plot. Turn 4 low-volume 'Come here' deictic address while Magpie remains at another table — instance of carried G3-C Sample-D spatial-claim completeness debt, not a new defect class.

SEQ-E.mechanism: Character cognition miss (Ivy T4) with prior transcript available
SEQ-E.finding: T4 Ivy claims 'Nobody else in this room did' see watch fixation; Harley T1/T3 explicitly noticed watch/Magpie fixation in committed transcript. Contradiction is social-knowledge coherence failure in generating Character cognition, not Plot advisory error. T1 Plot init forensic_persistence_failed — recovery did not prevent blemish.

SEQ-F.mechanism: Strong Continuity retention without progression differentiation
SEQ-F.finding: Looping despite excellent retention (repeated spectacle/taunt, Ivy 'shine half-life' refrain). Plot not present; looping is evidence that retention alone does not guarantee progression — does not prove Plot would prevent loops.

SEQ-B.mechanism: Conventional interview arc + mild environment-agency prose
SEQ-B.finding: Weakest blind sequence (4.40) despite Plot ON and healthy init lifecycle. Paired Plot-OFF rep-1 (SEQ-G) scores 5.00 — largest within-scenario arm gap. Suggests Plot did not rescue weaker thematic-variation interview arc.

plot_init_failure_mapping.confound_note: Sequence also contains T4 social-knowledge contradiction; init failure not sole explanation for lower score vs SEQ-A.
